verdict.rationale: Reducto's own docs offer a dedicated VPC deployment, a hybrid VPC model where all data and storage stay in the customer's VPC, and an air-gapped option. However, the hybrid model still sends ephemeral processing to Reducto's GPU infrastructure, and the air-gapped/self-hosted path appears only as a brief mention. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the dedicated VPC and fully self-hosted/air-gapped deployment (installation, components, requirements), confirmation that no data leaves customer infrastructure in those modes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can run the extraction stack in my own VPC or fully self-hosted when documents can't leave my infrastructure

citations.quote: Customers can choose between a dedicated VPC deployment, a hybrid VPC model, and a fully hosted SaaS model, balancing control, cost, and compute performance.
All data and storage reside in the customer’s VPC, while ephemeral processing is handled by Reducto’s dedicated GPU infrastructure.
